activation: Review suggestions only for card purchases with>=10 prior completed purchases and no v8 model alert. No fraud subtype prediction or probability.
calibration: 2016Q4 bucket3 card purchases; wide and short histories.
evaluation: Frozen v7 primary/diagnostic views, supplied scenario patterns and legitimate controls. Evaluation only after freeze; no tuning on these.
exposure: Reused IBM source/development. Only17 selection and19 calibration frauds; experimental review, no general precision/recall claim.
fit: 2015 to June2016 buckets0/1, native card purchases, existing full histories.
scope: Separate behavioral review; never change v8 fraud decisions or metrics.
selection: 2016Q3 bucket2 card purchases; wide and reconstructed short histories.
selection_rule: Maximize worst-view F1 subject to false-positive rate<=.001 in each view and pooled. Calibrate selected model once with same rule.
training: 300 trees, lr.06, l2 10, seed20261025, threads2; all fit fraud and deterministic10% negatives with inverse-inclusion weights10.
